definitions.explanation: Making something better, often through continuous small changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}したい。
examples.english: I want to improve my lifestyle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改善|かいぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{改善|かいぜん}している。

notes:
{改善|かいぜん} means improvement, especially through deliberate effort. It is also famous worldwide as a Japanese business philosophy ("kaizen") emphasizing continuous, incremental improvement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve ~
- {改善|かいぜん}の{余地|よち}: room for improvement
- {改善|かいぜん}{点|てん}: points to improve
- {改善|かいぜん}{策|さく}: improvement measures
- {改善|かいぜん}が{見|み}られる: improvement is observed

USAGE:
Applies broadly: {健康|けんこう}の{改善|かいぜん} (health improvement), {環境|かんきょう}{改善|かいぜん} (environmental improvement), {業務|ぎょうむ}{改善|かいぜん} (work process improvement).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改善|かいぜん}: general improvement (of conditions, situations)
- {改良|かいりょう}: improvement of products, systems, or methods
- {向上|こうじょう}: enhancement, raising to a higher level ({能力|のうりょく}の{向上|こうじょう} = skill improvement)
